text:
alex_k: Quick preflight — planning to run the users.email sparse-index + dual-write window next Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. Goal: create index, enable dual-write for 1h, run backfill on a follower with throttled workers. Who's on deploy/rollback?

maya_r: I can take the deploy lead (will be on call). planning to start canary at 02:00, full rollout 02:15 if canary looks good.

chris_t: I'll own DB rollback/runbook. If we see >2% error rate on write path or replication lag >5m we abort and revert dual-write toggle.

jin: I'll run the smoke checks and watch the shard metrics. I'll post the smoke checklist here and run it during canary.

sam_ir: CC @infra — please confirm follower replica is caught up and there's a recent snapshot. Also need confirmation on maintenance window in PagerDuty schedule.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance tag created for 2026-06-02 02:00 UTC by alex_k.

alex_k: Thanks. Small ops notes:
- Canary on 1% of traffic (route via canary flag)
- Backfill uses backfill-worker v2 with concurrency=4
- Rollback plan: disable dual-write -> stop backfill -> switch reads back to primary index -> drop sparse index if partially created (safe path).

jin: Smoke checklist (I'll run):
1) sanity: app health endpoints 200
2) write path: create test user with unique email -> app returns 201 and read-back on follower shows user within 90s
3) metrics: ingest rate stable, p95 latency not increasing >20%
4) replication: replica lag < 60s for 10m

--commands I'll run--
```
# check replica lag (example)
SELECT now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() AS replication_lag;
# simple write test
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.example/v1/users -d '{"email":"smoke+ts@example.com"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

chris_t: If smoke fails, immediate steps: 1) flip dual-write off, 2) route canary traffic back to stable model, 3) kick rollback runbook (link). I'll be on rotation and can execute.

maya_r: Ops checklist before 02:00: confirm follower snapshot (sam), ensure backfill-worker autoscale policy is set to limit to 4 concurrent (alex), add canary flag in release (maya).

sam_ir: Follower snapshot: yes, snapshot at 2026-05-31T23:10Z; replication health green. PagerDuty rotation confirmed — infra on-call will see alerts.

alex_k: OK. Owners: deploy=maya_r, rollback lead=chris_t, smoke=j in, infra contact=sam_ir. I'll create the runbook snippet and post the rollout command.

alex_k: rollout command (will run at 02:00 UTC):
```
# toggle index creation job (k8s job)
kubectl apply -f jobs/sparse-index-create.yaml --namespace=prod
# enable dual-write flag
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/flags/dual_write_users -d '{"enabled":true, "percent":1}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

jin: I'll watch logs and check metrics dashboards. If anything smells off > first 15m we abort.

chris_t: One more thing — ensure that the backfill worker writes idempotently and has a max retry cap. If not, we cap workers to 1 for first 30m.

maya_r: noted. I'll do canary at 1% then 10% after 15m if all green. Post the final go/no-go here at 02:14.

sam_ir: I'll leave infra alerts unmuted for this window and dial up retention for slow query logs for an extra 24h.

alex_k: Thanks team. I'll post the runbook link and a short checklist in #incidents (for visibility) ~30m before. If anyone can't make the window, please shout now. :thumbsup:

jin: all good from me.

chris_t: available.

maya_r: available.

sam_ir: available.

alex_k: great — locking in 2026-06-02 02:00-03:00 UTC. Final checklist will land at 01:30 UTC.
